summary: Netcapital Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into Securities Purchase Agreements and issuance of promissory notes totaling $444,550 principal for $275,000 proceeds, with original issue discounts of $19,550 and $150,000 respectively. The notes bear interest of 12-22%, mature in 2026-2027, and include prepayment and default provisions. This routine debt financing is not a special situation; it is a standard capital-raising agreement without change-of-control, restructuring, or strategic event implications. Recommend no further action.
